final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id AS oid, AVG((ili.product_price * 1.0) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS cnt FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s1
